events.title: Cactus League: Cubs vs Diamondbacks
events.venueName: Salt River Fields at Talking Stick
events.description: Catch the Chicago Cubs facing the Arizona Diamondbacks at Salt River Fields as the Cactus League spring training season wraps up. General admission and reserved seating available.

events.title: Cactus League: Giants vs Rockies
events.description: The San Francisco Giants host the Colorado Rockies at Scottsdale Stadium, one of the most intimate spring training venues in the Valley with its classic ballpark feel.

events.title: Cactus League: Dodgers vs White Sox
events.description: Watch the LA Dodgers take on the Chicago White Sox at Camelback Ranch in Glendale. The shared spring training complex features stunning mountain views beyond the outfield.

events.title: Cactus League: Mariners vs Padres
events.description: An evening spring training matchup between the Seattle Mariners and San Diego Padres under the lights at Peoria Sports Complex. Lawn seating is especially popular for night games.

events.title: Arizona Renaissance Festival
events.description: The final weekends of Arizona Renaissance Festival on a 30-acre village. Jousting, artisan crafts, turkey legs, 200-plus performers, and 14 stages of entertainment. Costumes encouraged.

events.title: Arizona Renaissance Festival
events.description: Final weekend of the Arizona Renaissance Festival season. Do not miss the grand closing celebration with extra performances, pyrotechnics, and the traditional farewell ceremony.

events.title: First Friday Phoenix Art Walk
events.venueAddress: Roosevelt St between 7th Ave and 16th St, Phoenix, AZ 85004
events.description: Phoenix's signature monthly art walk along Roosevelt Row. Galleries open late, food trucks line the streets, live music at multiple corners, and local artists sell work from pop-up booths.
events.imageKeyword: first friday phoenix art walk roosevelt row

events.title: First Friday Phoenix Art Walk
events.venueAddress: Roosevelt St between 7th Ave and 16th St, Phoenix, AZ 85004
events.description: May edition of First Friday along Roosevelt Row. The warm evening makes this an ideal month for the outdoor art walk. Expect muralists painting live, DJ sets, and gallery openings.

events.title: Scottsdale ArtWalk
events.venueAddress: Main Street and Marshall Way, Scottsdale, AZ 85251
events.description: Every Thursday evening, Scottsdale's galleries along Main Street and Marshall Way open their doors for free ArtWalk. Over 100 galleries, artist meet-and-greets, and complimentary refreshments.

events.title: Country Thunder Arizona 2026
events.venueAddress: 20585 E Price Station Rd, Florence, AZ 85132
events.description: Arizona's biggest country music festival returns for four days of headliner performances, camping, and country culture. Past headliners have included Luke Bryan, Morgan Wallen, and Eric Church. General admission and VIP packages available.

events.title: Arizona Diamondbacks vs Los Angeles Dodgers
events.description: Opening week of the MLB regular season at Chase Field. The D-backs host the rival Dodgers with the retractable roof and pool deck adding to the unique game-day experience.

events.title: Arizona Diamondbacks vs San Diego Padres
events.description: Tuesday evening baseball at Chase Field as the Diamondbacks host the Padres. Half-price hot dogs on Tuesdays make this a popular mid-week family outing.

events.title: Arizona Diamondbacks vs San Francisco Giants
events.description: Friday night at Chase Field with fireworks after the game. The D-backs face the Giants in this NL West matchup with postgame pyrotechnics lighting up the downtown Phoenix sky.

events.title: Arizona Bike Week 2026
events.description: One of the largest motorcycle rallies in the Southwest. Live music, stunt shows, custom bike competitions, vendor village, and group rides through the Arizona desert.

events.title: Concert Series at Ak-Chin Pavilion
events.description: The outdoor amphitheater season kicks off at Ak-Chin Pavilion, the Valley's premier outdoor concert venue. Check the venue schedule for the latest artist announcements for spring 2026.

events.title: Live Music at Desert Diamond Arena
events.description: Major touring acts perform at Desert Diamond Arena in the Westgate Entertainment District. The indoor arena seats 18,000 and is surrounded by restaurants and bars for pre-show dining.

events.title: Phoenix Suns vs Dallas Mavericks
events.description: Late-season NBA action as the Phoenix Suns face the Mavericks at Footprint Center in downtown Phoenix. The downtown arena sits adjacent to Chase Field and Heritage Square.

events.title: Phoenix Suns vs Golden State Warriors
events.description: The Suns host the Warriors in what could be a playoff-clinching matchup. The downtown Phoenix sports district is walkable between Footprint Center, restaurants, and light rail.

events.title: Old Town Scottsdale Farmers Market
events.venueAddress: Stetson Dr and Brown Ave, Scottsdale, AZ 85251
events.description: Every Saturday morning, local farmers, bakers, and artisans gather in Old Town Scottsdale. Fresh produce, baked goods, local honey, tamales, and hand-crafted items. Free parking nearby.

events.title: Uptown Farmers Market Phoenix
events.description: One of the Valley's most popular Saturday farmers markets along Central Avenue. Over 60 vendors selling farm-fresh produce, prepared foods, coffee, and artisan goods under the trees.

events.title: Gilbert Farmers Market
events.venueAddress: N Gilbert Rd and E Vaughn Ave, Gilbert, AZ 85234
events.description: The Saturday morning farmers market in downtown Gilbert's Heritage District. Live music, food trucks, fresh produce, and a friendly community atmosphere on the tree-lined streets.

events.title: Scottsdale Culinary Festival
events.description: Annual food and wine festival showcasing Scottsdale's best chefs and restaurants. Tastings, cooking demonstrations, craft cocktails, and live entertainment at the Civic Center park.

events.title: Sedona Arts Festival
events.venueAddress: 995 Upper Red Rock Loop Rd, Sedona, AZ 86336
events.description: A juried fine art show featuring 125 artists from across the country, set against Sedona's iconic red rock backdrop. Painting, sculpture, jewelry, photography, and glass art.

events.title: Tucson Second Saturdays Downtown
events.venueAddress: Congress St and 4th Ave, Tucson, AZ 85701
events.description: Tucson's monthly street festival along Congress Street and 4th Avenue. Free live music, open galleries, street performers, food vendors, and the creative energy of downtown Tucson.

events.title: Tucson Festival of Books
events.venueAddress: University Blvd and Cherry Ave, Tucson, AZ 85721
events.description: One of the largest book festivals in the country held on the University of Arizona campus. Author panels, book signings, 300-plus exhibitors, and free admission.

events.title: Full Moon Hike at South Mountain
events.description: Guided full moon hike through South Mountain Park, the largest municipal park in the nation at over 16,000 acres. Bring flashlights and water. Moderate difficulty, approximately 3 miles.

events.title: Mesa Riverview Outdoor Movie Night
events.venueAddress: 2100 W Rio Salado Pkwy, Mesa, AZ 85201
events.description: Free outdoor movie screening at Riverview Park near the Mesa Riverview shops. Bring blankets and lawn chairs. Food trucks on site. Family-friendly film selection.

events.title: Chandler Jazz Festival
events.venueAddress: Arizona Ave and Boston St, Chandler, AZ 85225
events.description: Free outdoor jazz performances in downtown Chandler. National and regional jazz acts perform on the main stage while local restaurants offer special menus. Seating is first-come, first-served.
